_doc: AegisGraph ASEMA DP2 — Claim → Evidence Traceability Matrix. Every claim in master proposal v0.3 is enumerated. Status taxonomy: A = anchored today and validator passes; E = anchored to engineering-stream output that lands by submission; P = planned/Phase II with limitation language. Forbidden status: I (implicit/unanchored).

claims.claim_text: ReproChain pre-disclosure simulation: AegisGraph would have surfaced libwebp CVE-2023-4863 attack-surface evidence pre-disclosure in Signal Android + Element X Android.
claims.limitation_language: Reproduction stops at AddressSanitizer-confirmed heap corruption on vendored vulnerable libwebp commit. No code execution, sandbox escape, or production-app exploitation claimed. On modern Android, libwebp is loaded by ImageDecoder framework, not directly by SMA. Static reachability is reachability evidence, not exploitation evidence.

claims.claim_text: PolyDiff rediscovers ≥3 known historical URL-parser disagreement bugs without seeding regression set.
claims.limitation_language: A parser disagreement is not a vulnerability per se. Security relevance asserted only after documented classifier rules in favor. PolyDiff does not run against live SMA services. Disclosure threshold cases handled per disclosure-handling owner.
